message: My electricity has been off in Ntinda since 6 a.m. Do you know when it will return?
I was charged twice for my August water bill.
There is water leaking continuously from the meter outside my house.
rationale: Requests attention for a meter-area leak.

message: I have moved into a new apartment and need electricity connected.
I cannot sign in to see my utility account online.
rationale: Concerns access to the customer's account.

message: Your call-centre agent was rude and no one has replied to my complaint for two weeks.
The lights keep flickering every evening, but my neighbours still have power.
rationale: Describes an electricity-supply interruption or instability.

message: My bill is high and there is also a leak near the meter. Which department should handle this?
rationale: Contains equally important billing and service issues, so it needs clarification rather than a guess.

message: Please send the latest statement to my new email address.
rationale: Requests an account-detail update and account document.
Nonsensical input with no interpretable utility issue.
